narration: Now, the word base. Picture a city under a dome. That is not what NASA describes, at least not yet.
visual_brief: Stylised glowing domed city on the Moon that dissolves into bare regolith.

candidates.title: Early Program Development
candidates.description: This 1970 artist's concept shows the Nuclear Shuttle and Space Tug operating in conjunction with other spacecraft to support lunar exploration. Marshall Space Flight Center plans during the late 1960s for lunar orbital and surface bases required extensive logistics operations in lunar orbit.
